units.title: Meet AI chatbots
units.summary: What a chatbot is, what it's good at, and what it gets wrong.

lessons.title: What is an AI chatbot?
lessons.objective: You'll send your first message to a chatbot.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 1, Lesson 1] Teach me what an AI chatbot is, in plain words. Keep it short, then let me try one.

lessons.title: What chatbots are good at
lessons.objective: You'll get a chatbot to write a short note for you.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 1, Lesson 2] Show me what AI chatbots are good at in everyday life, in plain words. Then let me try one.

lessons.title: What chatbots get wrong
lessons.objective: You'll see a chatbot get something wrong, and learn when to check.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 1, Lesson 3] Show me, in plain words, what AI chatbots get wrong and how to catch it. Then let me test you.

units.title: Your first conversations, safely
units.summary: Ask questions, follow up, keep private things private, and handle a fake family call.

lessons.title: Asking a real question
lessons.objective: You'll ask a chatbot a real question from your own week.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 2, Lesson 1] Teach me how to ask an AI chatbot a real question, in plain words. Then let me ask you one.

lessons.title: Following up
lessons.objective: You'll steer an answer with a follow-up, like "shorter" or "in plain words."
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 2, Lesson 2] Teach me how to follow up with an AI chatbot, including asking it for plainer words or a shorter answer. Then let me practice.

lessons.title: What never to share
lessons.objective: You'll get good help from a chatbot without sharing anything private.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 2, Lesson 3] Teach me what I should never share with an AI chatbot, and why. Then let me practice asking for help safely.

lessons.title: Fake calls that sound like family
lessons.objective: You'll know exactly what to do if a call sounds like family asking for money.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 2, Lesson 4] Teach me about AI voice-clone and family emergency scams, and exactly what to do if I get one of those calls. Then help me make a plan.

units.title: Getting good answers
units.summary: Small changes that get you clearer, more useful answers.

lessons.title: Be specific
lessons.objective: You'll turn a general question into one that gets a much better answer.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 3, Lesson 1] Teach me how adding details gets better answers from an AI chatbot. Then let me try it.

lessons.title: Tell it your situation
lessons.objective: You'll give a chatbot the background it needs, and leave out private details.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 3, Lesson 2] Teach me how to give an AI chatbot the right background so it can help me, without sharing private details. Then let me practice.

lessons.title: Ask for the downsides
lessons.objective: You'll get honest pros and cons from a chatbot, not only agreement.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 3, Lesson 3] Teach me how to get honest, balanced answers from an AI chatbot instead of agreement. Then let me practice.

units.title: Everyday tasks
units.summary: Emails, confusing letters, meal plans, and learning something new.

lessons.title: Write an email or letter
lessons.objective: You'll get a chatbot to write an email, then copy it out to use.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 4, Lesson 1] Teach me how to use an AI chatbot to help write an email or letter, and how to copy it out. Then let me try one.

lessons.title: Understand a confusing letter
lessons.objective: You'll get a confusing letter explained in plain words, with private parts covered.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 4, Lesson 2] Teach me how to use an AI chatbot to understand a confusing letter or bill, safely. Then let me practice with a made-up letter.

lessons.title: Meals, plans and lists
lessons.objective: You'll get a meal plan and a shopping list that fit the people you're feeding.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 4, Lesson 3] Teach me how to use an AI chatbot for recipes, plans and lists. Then let me try one.

lessons.title: Learn something new, with a photo
lessons.objective: You'll learn something new one step at a time, and try asking about a photo.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 4, Lesson 4] Teach me how to use an AI chatbot to learn something new, one step at a time, including by sharing a photo. Then let me try.

units.title: Using it wisely on your own
units.summary: Check what matters, know when to ask a person, spot scams, and start on your own.

lessons.title: Checking answers that matter
lessons.objective: You'll know which answers to check, and where to check them.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 5, Lesson 1] Teach me which AI answers to check and where to check them. Then let me practice.

lessons.title: Health, money and legal: ask a person
lessons.objective: You'll use AI to get ready for a doctor, banker or lawyer, not to decide for you.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 5, Lesson 2] Teach me how to use AI safely for health, money and legal questions, and when to ask a real person instead. Then let me practice.

lessons.title: Other scams that use AI
lessons.objective: You'll spot the signs of a scam, and know what to do if you already paid.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 5, Lesson 3] Teach me how scammers use AI in calls, emails, texts and pop-ups, the signs of any scam, and what to do if I already paid. Then let me practice spotting one.

lessons.title: On your own
lessons.objective: You'll know how to get a real chatbot app safely, and leave with your own safety rules.
lessons.starter: [BASICS: Unit 5, Lesson 4] Teach me how to use a chatbot app on my own, safely, and recap my safety rules. Then let me practice.
